description: This file contains test cases for the group policy helper functions related to 'zalouser' groups, including normalization, candidate building, and entry filtering.

methods.name: normalizeZalouserGroupSlug
methods.description: Normalizes a group slug name by trimming, lowercasing, and replacing spaces or symbols with hyphens.

methods.name: buildZalouserGroupCandidates
methods.description: Builds an array of candidate identifiers for a group based on provided properties, including optional aliases.

methods.name: findZalouserGroupEntry
methods.description: Finds the first group entry matching any of the candidates in a provided map.

methods.name: isZalouserGroupEntryAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a group entry is allowed based on its enabled and allow flags.
